title: Deep Symmetric Autoencoders from the Eckart-Young-Schmidt Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2506.11641v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep autoencoders have become a fundamental tool in various machine learning applications, ranging from dimensionality reduction and reduced order modeling of partial differential equations to anomaly detection and neural machine translation. Despite their empirical success, a solid theoretical foundation for their expressiveness remains elusive, particularly when compared to classical projection-based techniques. In this work, we aim to take a step forward in this direction by presenting a comprehensive analysis of what we refer to as symmetric autoencoders, a broad class of deep learning architectures that have surfaced frequently in the recent literature. Specifically, we introduce a formal distinction between different classes of symmetric architectures, analyzing their strengths and limitations from a mathematical perspective. translated_title: 基于Eckart-Young-Schmidt视角的深度对称自编码器
translated_abstract: 深度自编码器已成为各种机器学习应用中的基础工具，其应用范围涵盖降维、偏微分方程的降阶建模、异常检测以及神经机器翻译等领域。尽管在实证中取得了成功，但其表达能力仍然缺乏坚实的理论基础，尤其是与经典的基于投影的方法相比时更是如此。在这项工作中，我们旨在通过全面分析我们称之为“对称自编码器”的一类架构——这是近期文献中频繁出现的一大类深度学习架构——来朝这一方向迈进一步。具体而言，我们对不同类别的对称架构进行了形式化的区分，并从数学角度分析了它们的优势与局限性。例如，我们证明了具有正交性约束的对称自编码器的重构误差……
tldr: 本文从Eckart-Young-Schmidt理论的视角对深度对称自编码器进行了系统的数学分析，形式化地区分了不同类别的对称架构，并阐明了它们在表达能力上的优势与局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive mathematical analysis of deep symmetric autoencoders from the Eckart-Young-Schmidt perspective, formally distinguishing different classes of symmetric architectures and characterizing their expressiveness, strengths, and limitations.
